queries.name: tables
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TABLE_COUNT FROM QSYS2.SYSTABLES

queries.name: jobs
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS JOB_COUNT FROM TABLE(QSYS2.ACTIVE_JOB_INFO(SUBSYSTEM_LIST_FILTER => '*ALL')) X

queries.name: schemas
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM QSYS2.SYSTABLES GROUP BY TABLE_SCHEMA ORDER BY 2 DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
